$comment: Single source of truth for record layouts: where each field lives (offset), how it is read (type) and what it means. scripts/_layouts.js, tools/records.py and the offset listings in docs/MEMORY_LAYOUT.md are GENERATED from this file - edit here, then run `python tools/gen_layouts.py` (tests/test_layouts.py fails if they are stale). Types: u32, s32, s8, string (System.String*). Build-specific: re-verify on any new build.

DeviceQualityRecord.description: One entry of ExampleNamespace.DeviceQualityAllowList, as read from a hooked `...$$unpack` call.

fields.name: enabled
fields.doc: HD render quality on/off flag (observed as 0 or 1)

unread.name: szName_ByteArray
unread.doc: byte[]* - observed NULL every time and unused in practice; the real name is the System.String in `name`.

RecommendConfigRecord.description: One entry of ExampleNamespace.DeviceRecommendConfig, as read from a hooked `...$$unpack` call.

unread.name: unidentified
unread.doc: 8-byte region the investigation never resolved; not read by any agent. It is 8-aligned and sits before the first int32 run, which is consistent with a pointer field, but nothing here confirms that - treat it as unknown until you read it on your own build.

SelectionResult.description: The fields of RecommendConfigRecord that dump_selection_logic.js watches live. Both functions it hooks return a pointer to a full DeviceRecommendConfig record; only these fields are read.
